fusions.name: Levelling Pulse
fusions.desc: Brings a flattening pulse down on every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 30 damage and ignoring armour, with a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tack Down
fusions.desc: A tapping blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Plumb Line
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Flat Out
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 4% sooner.
